description_en: Uninstalls a Cloud Backup client from one or more Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
description_zh: 为一台或者多台ECS实例卸载备份客户端
kebab_example: aliyun hbr uninstall-backup-clients --instance-ids '[i-0xi5wj500000v3j3bh2gj5]' --client-ids '[c-000000000000000000000]' --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 129349237 --cross-account-role-name BackupRole --region cn-hangzhou
name: UninstallBackupClients

parameters.help_en: The IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 ECS instances
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of Cloud Backup clients. The sum of the number of Cloud Backup client IDs and the number of ECS instance IDs cannot exceed 20. Otherwise, an error occurs
parameters.help_zh: 备份客户端ID。客户端ID与ECS实例ID的数量之和不能超过20个，否则报错
parameters.name: client_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether data is backed up and restored within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up and restored within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up and restored across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up and restore data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up and restore data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name
